open.recommended_reason: Plain Romanian that a reader without English understands at first read, and the catalog majority (concentr* in 72 keys against focus* in 30). The pre-registered harvest condition was applied on 2026-09-16 and did not flip it (see note).
open.note: Archived guide section 7 prefers 'sesiune de focus'; the catalog has 3 keys with 'sesiune de focus' and 2 with 'sesiune de concentrare' (term_audit, snapshot 2026-09-15); across all ro copy the stem 'concentr*' appears in 72 keys against 'focus*' in 30 (whole-word 'focus' in 29); the same-source group 'Focus' renders as Focus (insights.focus.title, profile.sessionDetails.splitFocus) and Concentrare (profile.home.focusSection). Decide before the first ro batch; a flip is a global term change with its own follow-up batch, never a per-string choice. Harvest 2026-09-16 (iOS 26.1 (23B86) runtime: Applications/Preferences.app | Localizable.strings | Focus; System/Library/ControlCenter/Bundles/FocusUIModule.bundle | Localizable.strings | MODULE_DEFAULT_TITLE): iOS ro names the system Focus mode 'Concentrare', so the first half of the pre-registered rule holds. The second half does not: no key names the system mode, the app ships no Focus filter, iOS never says 'sesiune', and en already shares 'Focus' with the iOS mode, so ro carries the overlap en accepted. What changed: recommended_reason no longer carries the pending condition; recommended stays 'sesiune de concentrare'. The exact overlap is on bare labels, 'Concentrare' (profile.home.focusSection, en 'Focus') and 'Concentrare în desfășurare' (onboarding.welcome.preview.blocking.active); the owner may weigh that as confusion and flip.
